title: Local Nature Guide
engine: custom DOM/canvas game with shared QLOBE audio, HUD, tap, timer, preload, and debug modules
shareTitle: Local Nature Guide — Three Woodland Discovery Trails
description: Join Suri the squirrel in a sunlit watercolor woodland. Find familiar forest treasures, match three distinctive bird calls, trace animal tracks, and collect nine discoveries in a persistent nature journal.
learningGoals: Identify familiar forest objects by shape and visual detail
Discriminate between contrasting chickadee, robin, and woodpecker call patterns
Recognize rabbit, deer, and raccoon tracks
Practice controlled finger tracing from a clear starting point
Recall a short nature fact from a collected journal specimen
interactionModel: choose one of three art-led trails; tap a named forest specimen, listen and match a bird call, or trace a footprint ribbon before matching its animal; every correct discovery visibly flies into the Nature Journal
feedbackModel: Suri gives warm recorded guidance, incorrect choices receive a gentle in-world nudge, correct finds bloom with an authored watercolor glow and transfer into the persistent journal, and completing all nine discoveries awards the guide badge

modes.title: Forest Finds
modes.skill: visual discrimination of familiar woodland specimens

assets.art: Watercolor / Storybook raster family generated with GPT Image 2, adapted with Qwen Image Edit, separated with Qwen Image Layered, cut with tools/cut-asset-sheet.py, and deterministically alpha-QA'd; Krea 2 supplies the separate Toy-table hub tile.
assets.voice: Qwen3 TTS voice clone teacher narration, normalized to AAC and fail-closed after per-line Whisper transcript QA; Web Speech remains the offline-safe fallback.
assets.birdCalls: Three distinctive child-safe call patterns synthesized locally at runtime with WebAudio; no external runtime requests.

credits: Kaigani; concept brief and mockups by Kaigani; visual development with GPT Image 2, Krea 2, and Qwen Image Edit/Layered; teacher narration with Qwen3 TTS. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids. See ASSETS.md.
